_comment: What a dismissal can be remembered for: [checkType, item key, mark family or null]. The worker (workers/src/dismissals.py) matches rules with it and the API (@cdip/shared dismissalFamily) offers the same family; both suites read this file so the two cannot drift.
_sameItem: [a, b, same]: a mark is printed with or without its hyphen (PC4 on one sheet, PC-4 on the next); a dot is part of the mark (F6.0 is not F60).
